title: GAO keeps the NNSA pit-production lifecycle-cost recommendation open in April 2026
summary: GAO reports that, as of April 2026, NNSA had not developed a lifecycle cost estimate aligned with GAO best practices and forecast a December 2026 estimate after SRPPF design work. Denominator: The enterprise program to establish and sustain pit production across Los Alamos and Savannah River, evaluated against GAO schedule and lifecycle-cost best practices.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Rate, capacity, and baseline hold.
